suite.doc: EC IUD Test - Canal (Configuration > Assets > Transport Objects > Canal, CO.2069). Manage-Object (OV) screen. DELETE = End Date = Start Date (true delete in OV_CANAL). Layered: this test -> canal_page (T3) -> manage_object (T2) + common (T1). NEVER touch existing data.
